IVX FINAL 3-ITEM CLOSEOUT — COMPLETE TO 100% VERIFIED

OWNER DIRECTIVE

We are not redesigning IVX.

The infrastructure migration is already substantially complete.

Current verified PASS:
- DIRECT_GITHUB_WRITE = PASS
- CI = PASS
- DIRECT_RENDER_DEPLOY = PASS

ONLY 3 ITEMS REMAIN:

1. SOAK TEST = IN_PROGRESS
2. AUTONOMOUS_INDEPENDENT_TASK = NOT_EXECUTED
3. ANDROID_BUILD = NOT_EXECUTED

MISSION:

Complete these three items one by one.

Do not reopen completed architecture work.
Do not add unrelated features.
Do not produce another plan.
Do not ask what to do next.
Do not fabricate elapsed time, task results, APK builds, credentials, SHAs, deploy IDs, or evidence.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — COMPLETE THE SOAK TEST
==================================================

Current soak monitor is already running.

First:

1. Find the existing monitor process.
2. Verify it is still running.
3. Verify results are being persisted.
4. Verify the result file is updating.
5. Do not restart the timer unless the existing monitor is invalid.

Required minimum observation:
2 REAL HOURS.

Do not claim PASS before 2 real hours have elapsed.

Monitor:

- /health
- /version
- production SHA
- databaseConfigured
- Supabase/Auth
- AI provider
- public chat
- owner AI
- queue depth
- worker heartbeat
- active tasks
- dead letters
- 4xx
- 5xx
- timeouts
- Render restarts
- database failures
- provider failures
- queue stalls

For the completed run return:

SOAK_START=
SOAK_END=
SOAK_DURATION=
REQUESTS=
SUCCESS=
FAILURES=
4XX=
5XX=
TIMEOUTS=
RESTARTS=
QUEUE_STALLS=
DATABASE_FAILURES=
PROVIDER_FAILURES=
P50=
P95=
P99=
MAX_LATENCY=

If Render cold starts occur:

classify them separately.

Do not label a normal free-tier/cold-start event as an application defect unless the application itself fails to recover.

Required final result:

SOAK_TEST = PASS

Only after real 2-hour evidence.

If Item 1 is still running:
continue to Item 2 and Item 3 while the monitor runs.

==================================================
ITEM 2 — RUN THE AUTONOMOUS INDEPENDENT TASK
==================================================

This must prove IVX IA can perform a real engineering task WITHOUT Rork infrastructure.

Current blocker reportedly relates to IVX_OWNER_TOKEN.

DO NOT ask the owner to paste or recreate credentials first.

Step A — verify runtime binding.

Check whether the existing production/runtime environment already contains the owner authorization required for:

- owner authentication
- IVX IA autonomous task creation
- GitHub write
- Render deployment

For IVX_OWNER_TOKEN report ONLY:

VARIABLE_PRESENT = true/false
BOUND_TO_RUNTIME = true/false
AUTH_REQUEST_EXECUTED = true/false
HTTP_STATUS=
ERROR_CATEGORY=

Never print the token.

If the variable is present but unavailable to the current shell:

do NOT classify the credential itself as missing.

Identify the binding/context problem.

Use an existing owner-authenticated service path if available.

Only report credential replacement required if a real request proves:

- HTTP 401
- HTTP 403 due token validity/scope
- token expired
- token revoked
- token missing from the actual runtime
- token deleted

==================================================
ITEM 2B — EXECUTE A REAL TASK
==================================================

Select one SMALL but REAL IVX production improvement.

NOT ALLOWED:

- proof-only module
- label change
- timestamp change
- documentation-only edit
- sentinel string
- fake endpoint
- certification-only code

Good examples:

- fix a genuine chat reliability issue
- improve a real health/queue endpoint
- fix a real mobile bug
- improve a real error handler
- improve authentication/session reliability
- resolve an existing real test defect

IVX IA must complete:

OWNER REQUEST
→ TASK CREATED
→ ANALYSIS
→ REAL CODE CHANGE
→ TESTS
→ DIRECT GITHUB COMMIT
→ PR
→ CI
→ MERGE
→ DIRECT RENDER DEPLOYMENT
→ PRODUCTION VERIFICATION
→ RESULT RETURNED TO IVX IA CHAT

NO Rork git router.

NO Rork deployment.

NO Rork SDK/toolkit.

NO manual code editing.

Owner approval may be used only where an actual protected approval gate requires it.

Capture:

TASK_ID=
JOB_ID=
TASK_DESCRIPTION=
FILES_CHANGED=
LINES_ADDED=
LINES_REMOVED=
TEST_COMMANDS=
TEST_RESULTS=

==================================================
ITEM 3 — ANDROID PRODUCTION BUILD
==================================================

Do not mark this blocked merely because the current Rork container lacks Android SDK.

Use an OWNER-CONTROLLED build path.

Preferred order:

A. Existing owner-controlled EAS Build
B. GitHub Actions Android build environment
C. Owner-controlled Android SDK/Gradle runner

First inspect the project for existing:

- eas.json
- Expo project ID
- Android package name
- signing configuration
- build profiles
- EAS owner/project configuration

Do not ask for new credentials until you verify whether the configured build environment can already access them.

==================================================
ITEM 3A — CREATE FINAL ANDROID BUILD
==================================================

Build from the EXACT final GitHub SHA.

Required:

- production build profile
- production API endpoint
- no Rork endpoints
- no debug endpoint
- no private server secret in client bundle
- valid package ID
- valid versionCode
- valid versionName
- signed build

Return:

ANDROID_BUILD_PROVIDER=
BUILD_ID=
BUILD_SHA=
PACKAGE_ID=
VERSION_NAME=
VERSION_CODE=
ARTIFACT_TYPE=
BUILD_STATUS=

Required:
BUILD_STATUS = SUCCESS

==================================================
ITEM 3B — ANDROID QA
==================================================

Verify:

- install
- launch
- splash/loading screen
- member registration
- member login
- session restore
- logout
- public chat
- IVX IA Chat
- owner AI if applicable
- background
- foreground
- network disconnect
- reconnect
- slow network
- app restart
- production API
- no Rork request
- no crash

Return:

ANDROID_LAUNCH = PASS
ANDROID_AUTH = PASS
ANDROID_CHAT = PASS
ANDROID_RECOVERY = PASS
ANDROID_NETWORK_RORK_REQUESTS = 0

Then:

ANDROID_BUILD = PASS

==================================================
ITEM 4 — WAIT FOR SOAK COMPLETION
==================================================

After Items 2 and 3 complete:

return to the existing soak monitor.

Do not start a new soak unless necessary.

Wait until the original valid monitor reaches at least 2 real hours.

Read the persisted results.

Verify:

- monitor did not silently stop
- sampling interval remained valid
- no missing long gaps
- production SHA stayed expected
- no unexplained crash/restart
- no persistent 5xx
- no queue deadlock
- no auth outage
- no provider stuck state

Then mark:

SOAK_TEST = PASS

or

SOAK_TEST = FAIL

with evidence.

==================================================
ITEM 5 — FINAL RORK ZERO CHECK
==================================================

Because Items 2 and 3 must also remain independent, rerun the zero-Rork verification AFTER those tasks.
